s.n: Red Sea tomato soup with grilled cheese
s.note: Bruce parts his tomato soup. Roast tomato soup, a cheddar toastie to dip.
s.how: Toss the tomatoes, onion and garlic with the oil and salt and roast at 200C until soft and blistered. Blend with the stock and sugar, then simmer, stir in the cream and season. Fill the bread with cheddar, butter the outsides and toast in a pan until golden and melting. Cut the toasties into fingers and serve with the soup, for parting or dunking.

s.note: Bruce makes the Sabres win the Cup. Hot sauce wings, blue cheese dip, celery.
s.how: Pat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and a teaspoon of salt. Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once, until crisp and golden. Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream, mayo and a squeeze of lemon. Melt the butter into the hot sauce and toss the wings through it.

m.n: Evan's prime rib roast with horseradish cream
m.note: The Prime rib roast Minister, says Evan. Slow-roast rib of beef, jus, mash, greens.
m.how: Rub the beef with the oil, garlic, pepper and plenty of salt and bring to room temperature. Roast at 230C for 15 minutes, then at 160C until it reads 54C inside for medium rare. Rest the beef under foil while you make the jus from the pan juices and stock. Meanwhile boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and milk, and steam the beans. Stir the horseradish into the sour cream, carve the beef and serve with everything.

w.note: Bruce answers every prayer Yes. Every topping at once, under hot fudge.
w.how: Heat the cream and golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir into a glossy fudge. Layer banana, strawberries and scoops of ice cream in 4 tall glasses. Pour over the hot fudge, then add the cream, peanuts, sprinkles and a cherry each.

d.note: Bruce manifests himself some coffee. Colombian cold brew, condensed milk, ice.
d.how: Stir the coffee into the cold water and leave in the fridge for 12 hours, then strain. Spoon condensed milk into 4 glasses and fill with ice. Pour over the cold brew and top with milk, then stir.
